svg.aria-label: Flyer asking What is the model looking at? Explainable AI on COVID-19 chest X-rays and clinical data. A halftone chest X-ray made of dots is scanned and a Grad-CAM hotspot lights up in orange. Below, a SHAP-style swarm shows what drives the prediction: clinical notes, age, X-ray view and sex. SHAP, LIME, Grad-CAM, Random Forest, XGBoost, CNN. Not a diagnostic tool.
